evidence.quote: An API key is a secure hashed token used to authenticate with Bright Data API.
The Bright Data MCP server gives AI agents and assistants real-time access to public web data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

result.notes: Proxy "native access" credentials (customer:zone:password over proxy protocol) function like HTTP basic auth alongside the primary bearer-token API key scheme. Composio catalog and unauth probe (401 on invalid creds) corroborate api_key/bearer auth. Free self-serve signup confirmed on marketing site; exact free-tier request/data limits not itemized on pages fetched. API breadth not fully enumerated (llms.txt index not fetched due to budget) but spans Web Unlocker, SERP, Scraping Browser, Scraper/Dataset APIs, and zone/proxy management — estimated medium.
result.one_liner: Bright Data is a web-data platform providing proxy networks, a Web Unlocker, SERP API, scraping browser, and dataset/scraper APIs for programmatic web scraping.
